headline: Gameweek 11 transfer talk is heavy, so keep your 15-minute window simple and decide on your gut.

points.text: Several creators are debating Gameweek 11 moves, including whether to sell Haaland and whether to keep or sell Man United attackers.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Creators disagree on whether to use a Free Hit chip, and on which week would suit it best.
points.label: opinion

points.text: One creator shares a full Gameweek 11 team and says to hold off on the chip choice for now.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Many videos in this set are paid promotions for a fantasy football tool, marked as ads.
points.label: reported

differences.text: One creator asks whether selling Haaland is crazy. Another frames the Man United attackers as a keep-or-sell choice.
One video asks whether to play a transfer or chip now, or wait. Another says the Free Hit week should be chosen after comparing several weeks.
